import numpy as np
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

tr=np.load('/app/data/train.npz',allow_pickle=False)
va=np.load('/app/data/val.npz',allow_pickle=False)
te=np.load('/app/data/test.npz',allow_pickle=False)

Xtr=tr['spikes'].reshape(len(tr['spikes']),-1)
ytr=tr['label']
Xva=va['spikes'].reshape(len(va['spikes']),-1)
yva=va['label']
Xall=np.vstack([Xtr,Xva])
yall=np.concatenate([ytr,yva])

print('train class counts',np.bincount(ytr,minlength=10))
print('val class counts  ',np.bincount(yva,minlength=10))

# consistency checks
mt_tr=tr['movie_time_s']; mt_va=va['movie_time_s']
map_tr=np.round((mt_tr-10.0)/0.5).astype(int)
map_va=np.round((mt_va-10.0)/0.5).astype(int)
print('train label-time mismatches',np.sum(map_tr"'!=ytr),'"'of',len(ytr))
print('val label-time mismatches',np.sum(map_va"'!=yva),'"'of',len(yva))

models={
'logreg_l2': make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000,multi_class='multinomial')),
'linearsvc': make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LinearSVC()),
'rf': RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=0)
}

skf=StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=True,random_state=0)
for n,m in models.items():
    s=cross_val_score(m,Xall,yall,cv=skf,scoring='accuracy')
    print(n,'cv mean',s.mean(),'std',s.std(),s)

# holdout test: train->val
for n,m in models.items():
    m.fit(Xtr,ytr)
    p=m.predict(Xva)
    print(n,'train->val',accuracy_score(yva,p))
